purpose: Frozen ACT development panel for component-decoupled temporal aggregation.

policy.postprocessing: Extract same-target candidates after the native policy and environment postprocessors.

tasks.task_name: pick up the butter and place it in the basket
pick up the black bowl from table center and place it on the plate
put the bowl on the stove
put the black bowl in the bottom drawer of the cabinet and close it

method_semantics.fresh: Use the newest same-target candidate for all seven action dimensions.
method_semantics.official_act_m001: Full available history; one shared weight vector proportional to exp(-0.01 source_index), with candidates ordered oldest to newest.
method_semantics.cogact_full_alpha01: Full available history; one shared weight vector proportional to exp(0.1 full_action_cosine(candidate, newest)).
method_semantics.matched_shared_a16_alpha03_beta003: Keep candidates with source age <=16; one shared weight vector proportional to exp(0.3 full_action_cosine(candidate, newest) - 0.03 age).
method_semantics.cdta_a16_alpha03_beta003: Keep candidates with source age <=16; independently weight arm by exp(0.3 arm_cosine - 0.03 age) and gripper by exp(0.3 sign(gripper)sign(newest_gripper) - 0.03 age), then ordinary weighted aggregation. No gripper sign vote.

analysis.primary_comparison: CDTA versus matched shared on identical task, state, and environment-seed pairs.
analysis.primary_gate: After all 200 episodes: CDTA candidate-only successes minus matched-shared reference-only successes >=3/40, and CDTA success count >= matched shared on at least 3/4 tasks.
analysis.fresh_safeguard: Pooled CDTA success count may be at most 2 below Fresh; on no task may Fresh-only minus CDTA-only paired loss reach 2/10.
